evidence.quote: unemployment has now returned to its pre-pandemic lows, even as we have worked to return inflation to our 2 percent objective.
This is wise considering that the past three decades have shown that unemployment can fall well below the levels that economists once predicted would overheat the economy.
Economists also understand that employment is the key to a healthy economy.
